Data Inventory

Enums, interfaces and schemas; canonical definitions and review evidence.

Canonical enums, interfaces and schemas, with explicit ownership, reusable definitions and source evidence.

Fully Defined means the documentation contract is complete within its stated responsibility. Needs Decision identifies a partial contract with a recorded unresolved question. Neither status certifies runtime behavior or game balance. Existing/Proposed records provenance separately from completeness.

CrusaderCombatStateProposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Authoritative crusader signature history; shared resources, statuses, summons and debt are referenced rather than stored twice.

Responsibility: runtime state
Authority: owning world process

PropertyTypePresenceMeaning / constraints
character_idIdRequiredCharacter id. Reference: CharacterRecord (instance).
seal_mark_idsset of IdRequiredSeal mark ids.
conviction_resource_idResourceTypeRequiredResource definition ID selecting this owner’s canonical ResourcePoolState; not a separate pool instance or balance.
  • 100 Conviction shared with class; +10 eligible generator; three target Seals maximum; finisher spends 30 Conviction and available Seals.
  • The cited resource contract governs over inherited flavor labels. Pool IDs resolve the CharacterState resource map; marks/status/device IDs resolve shared runtime stores.
  • Sustained resource belongs to CharacterState; only signature-specific references and history live here.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

Related contracts: CharacterRecord · Id · ResourceType

  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "character_id": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/Id",
      "description": "Character id.",
      "x-reference": {
        "target": "CharacterRecord",
        "kind": "instance"
      }
    },
    "seal_mark_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/$defs/Id"
      },
      "description": "Seal mark ids.",
      "uniqueItems": true
    },
    "conviction_resource_id": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/ResourceType",
      "description": "Resource definition ID selecting this owner’s canonical ResourcePoolState; not a separate pool instance or balance."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "character_id",
    "conviction_resource_id",
    "seal_mark_ids"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "description": "Authoritative crusader signature history; shared resources, statuses, summons and debt are referenced rather than stored twice.",

    "100 Conviction shared with class; +10 eligible generator; three target Seals maximum; finisher spends 30 Conviction and available Seals."

Authority: owning world process

PropertyTypePresenceMeaning / constraints
item_idIdRequiredItem id. Reference: ItemInstance (instance).

  • Globally unique item_id; quantity > 0 for an extant instance. Durability is null for non-durable items.

  • Runtime ItemInstance is an authorized view of durable instance/ownership state, not a second writable inventory. grade derives from current definition; binding records the current instance transition, not initial blueprint policy.
  • Instance version and ownership version identify the same atomic revision; intentionally retained for optimistic ownership validation.

Inspect canonical definition

Resolved ability definition.

Responsibility: runtime state
Authority: owning world process

PropertyTypePresenceMeaning / constraints
ability_idIdRequiredAbility id. Reference: AbilityDefinition (content).
content_versionstringRequiredContent version.
build_versionVersionRequiredBuild version.
targetingAbilityTargetingPolicyRequiredTargeting.
timingAbilityTimingPolicyRequiredTiming.
costsarray of ResolvedResourceCostRequiredCosts.
effectsarray of EffectOperationDefinitionRequiredEffects.
bindings_resolvedbooleanRequiredBindings resolved.
data_tests_passedbooleanRequiredData tests passed.
runtime_tests_passedbooleanRequiredRuntime tests passed.
  • Runtime requires all three readiness gates; profile presence alone is insufficient.
  • Resolve base → specialization → exclusive transform → additive families → declared multiplicative families → item effects → source buffs → PvP → clamps; recipient defense occurs on effect resolution.
  • Separate certified runtime composition from AbilityDefinition, which preserves the prototype source record. No duplicate mutable ability definition is persisted.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

Resource pool state.

Responsibility: runtime state
Authority: owning world process

PropertyTypePresenceMeaning / constraints
resource_idResourceTypeRequiredResource id.
currentCombatAmountRequiredCurrent.
maximumCombatAmountRequiredMaximum.
reservedCombatAmountRequiredReserved.
recovery_per_secondCombatAmountRequiredCurrent authoritative automatic recovery rate in this resource units/second; zero for exclusively action-generated pools.
  • 0 <= reserved <= current <= maximum. One owner pool per actual resource, including class/specialization aliases.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.
  • maximum and recovery_per_second are derived views of resolved stats/content, recomputed atomically on build changes. current and reserved are the mutable balances; no client-supplied value is authoritative.

Inspect canonical definition

Exact existing ability command name and example fields; owner and spatial scope derive from the authenticated world session.

Responsibility: network request
Authority: authenticated client intent; server validates and derives actor

PropertyTypePresenceMeaning / constraints
schema"ability_command_v2"RequiredEstablished wire-schema discriminator. {"const": "ability_command_v2"}
session_epochVersionRequiredSession epoch.
command_sequenceCountRequiredCommand sequence.
character_idIdRequiredCharacter id. Reference: CharacterRecord (instance).
ability_idIdRequiredAbility id. Reference: AbilityDefinition (content).
build_versionVersionRequiredBuild version.
content_versionstringRequiredContent version.
target_entity_idId | nullRequiredTarget entity id. Reference: EntitySnapshot (instance).
aim_pointVector2 | nullRequiredAim point.
aim_directionVector2 | nullRequiredAim direction.
requested_charge_spendCountOptional (may be absent)Requested charge spend.
  • schema is ability_command_v2. The example does not settle required-vs-optional intent fields; current canonical presence rules remain Needs Decision.
  • Repeated (session_epoch, command_sequence) returns the prior acceptance/rejection/result reference. No damage, health, resource balance, random seed, position or cooldown completion from client.
  • requested_charge_spend applies only to declared charge spenders; Charge Lance spends 1..4 and requires sufficient available charges.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

ItemOwnershipRecordProposed · Needs Decision · Needs Review · Review question
Inspect canonical definition

Item ownership record.

Responsibility: persistent record
Authority: durable transactional service

PropertyTypePresenceMeaning / constraints
item_idIdRequiredItem id. Reference: ItemInstance (instance).
owner_account_idId | nullRequiredExplicitly no current value is permitted. Reference: AccountRecord (instance).
owner_character_idId | nullRequiredOwner character id. Reference: CharacterRecord (instance).
owner_guild_idId | nullRequiredOwner guild id. Reference: GuildRecord (instance).
container_idIdRequiredContainer id. Reference: InventoryContainer (instance).
versionVersionRequiredVersion.
reservation_idId | nullRequiredReservation id.
  • Exactly one owner scope; guild-owned items may lack personal owner. Customer-bound escrow remains customer-owned. Reservation blocks competing operations.
  • No independently mutable copy in InventoryRecord, EquipmentSet, market listing or delivery. Item revision coordinates atomic ownership and instance changes.
  • Personal ownership requires account + character; guild ownership uses guild ID with null personal owner fields. Account-bound eligibility is checked through the personal account.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

Related contracts: AccountRecord · CharacterRecord · GuildRecord · Id · InventoryContainer · ItemInstance · Version

Coverage

49 feature pages and 53 source pages reviewed; 49 feature pages have Data sections. All 501 original structures examined; 165 remain partial / Needs Decision.

  • Enums: 83 total, 33 fully defined.
  • Interfaces: 168 total, 146 fully defined.
  • Schemas: 250 total, 157 fully defined.
  • Coverage is against current documented mechanics, including supporting operations and test evidence. Catalog labels for existing unnamed formats do not rename source files or established wire names.
  • Each named ability, talent and recipe is content within a shared format, not a distinct contract. Specialization combat states are separate because their documented histories and decision loops differ.
  • Housing, territory construction, sieges, detailed authored maps, racial geography, neutral trade, long offline manufacturing and mandatory voice chat have no current baseline requirements. No contracts are invented for those deferred or absent features.
  • Quest and world entries cover the documented starter journey, objective tracking, safe locations and explicit transitions. Authored narrative remains deferred.
  • All 501 original stable entries were examined as connected contracts. Reclassified catalog identifiers retain their original names and anchors. Logical schemas are documentation contracts; unresolved gameplay, security and encoding choices are explicitly blocked.

Conventions and ownership

  • Canonical definitions live only in this registry. The generated schema bundle and HTML are read-only projections. Existing feature HTML and shipped data remain evidence, not alternate contract editors.
  • snake_case properties follow existing JSON and ability_command_v2. Existing mixed-case keys such as weapon_DPS are preserved for compatibility. Stable inventory IDs and anchors never change when classification changes.
  • Required means present; nullable permits explicit null. Optional fields may be absent. No implicit default exists. Empty collections mean a known empty set; null means no current selection or applicability as described per field.
  • Id is an opaque stable string, with a field-level x-reference naming its content definition or instance contract. Content references do not embed live entities. Entity IDs, account IDs, character IDs, item instance IDs and content IDs occupy different namespaces.
  • Numbers are finite. CombatAmount is measured in domain units with fixed-point thousandths, with final health rounding at resolution. Seconds are durations; Instant is an absolute authoritative timestamp in RFC 3339 UTC (a structural proposal; no existing epoch encoding is changed). WorldPoint includes zone, instance, floor and foot-anchor coordinates in authored tile widths.
  • Currency is integer minor units. No currency name, exchange rate, cap or new currency is introduced. Fractions are 0..1; fields explicitly named percent use 0..100. Existing formula coefficients retain their documented scale.
  • Arrays preserve order unless uniqueItems and set semantics are declared. Maps are keyed by the referenced stable ID. Runtime collections with unique entities use keyed maps or unique ID sets. No derived display owns a second mutable copy.
  • Enum members are symbolic identifiers unless representation is established. x-members documents a finite domain without assigning a wire encoding. enum contains only established serialized values. New boundary encodings remain a review decision, never implicit numeric ordinals.
  • Static content is versioned by the package content version. Runtime state belongs to the owning world process; durable economic ownership belongs to the transactional service. Client requests carry intent and expected versions, never authoritative results.
  • A Fully Defined shape is supported at documentation level, not runtime-ready or balanced. Needs Decision schemas validate only their supported portion and cannot certify an unresolved mechanic. Text invariants require future semantic/runtime validation beyond structural JSON Schema.

Identity, creation and progression

AccountRecord owns accounts; CharacterRecord owns character identity; CharacterProgressRecord owns earned progression; TalentBuildRecord owns applied selections. UI drafts and snapshots derive from them.

AccountRecord · CharacterRecord · CharacterState · CharacterCreationDraft · TalentBuildRecord · CharacterLoadout · RoleTrainingDefinition · QuestProgressRecord · TutorialProgressRecord

Combat, abilities and class state

World process owns resources, casts, statuses, threat, summons and debt. ResolvedAbilityDefinition composes the content profile with one applied build; all 37 specialization states reference shared pools, marks and schedules.

AbilityDefinition · ResolvedAbilityDefinition · ResourcePoolState · StatusInstance · PeriodicEffectSchedule · DamageLedger · SummonCapacityState · TriggerContext · CombatResult

Items, professions and economy

ItemOwnershipRecord and WalletRecord are durable truth. Inventory, equipment, escrow, listings and deliveries refer to the same instances. Craft acceptance snapshots mastery; settlements and outbox commit atomically.

ItemDefinition · ItemInstance · ItemOwnershipRecord · InventoryContainer · EquipmentSet · RecipeDefinition · CraftJob · CraftOrderRecord · MarketListingRecord · CurrencyLedgerRecord · OperationReceipt · TransactionalOutboxRecord

World, NPCs, quests and groups

Definitions own content; world instances own execution. Party membership and participation are snapshotted only when reward eligibility requires historical truth. Guild permissions reuse the transactional item path.

WorldLocationDefinition · NpcDefinition · NpcState · QuestDefinition · QuestProgressRecord · PartyState · GuildMembership · RewardEligibilitySnapshot · RewardGrantRecord

Network, persistence and operations

SessionOwnershipRecord fences one owner epoch. Requests never override domain authority. EntitySnapshot is a filtered public projection; reconnect and transfer checkpoints are private owner state. Economic receipts survive combat recovery.

SessionAuthority · SessionOwnershipRecord · ability_command_v2 · MovementIntent · EntitySnapshot · ReconnectSnapshot · TransferCheckpoint · TransferToken · AdministrativeActionRecord · ValidationReport

Needs Review

Open questions block only the affected contracts. Resolved questions remain here to preserve review anchors and reasoning.

Resource terminology (resolved)

Several class and specialization labels differ from their resource contracts: Grace/Devotion, Soul Threshold/Soul Essence, Maelstrom/Stormcharge, Pact Shards/Authority, and Focus Windows/Aim. Confirm the eventual public terminology without creating duplicate meters.

Alternatives: Keep resource-contract labels and map legacy display aliases. / Rename public labels after content review.
Recommendation: Resolved: standardize public resource labels to Devotion, Soul Essence, Stormcharge, Authority and Aim, following the explicit resource contracts. Marksman Focus remains the separate sustained resource. Preserve stable IDs and one canonical pool per actual resource.
Impact: Legacy resource labels were renamed across class guidance, ability/talent catalogs, embedded character data and search. No gain, spend, cap or other resource behavior changed. Marksman accuracy behavior remains a separate open decision.

Recommendation: The global healer Mana rule governs; individually bind conflicting Balm Chorus/talents.

Start commit policy (open)

The cast lifecycle permits a non-channel start-commit override, but shipped timing_policy tokens cover only release_commit and channel_start_commit. What exact token/semantics will represent that override?

Alternatives: Add an explicit versioned non-channel start-commit token. / Constrain initial content to the two existing policies.
Recommendation: Keep shipped tokens; define the additional policy only when an enabled ability requires it.
Impact: The supported symbolic alternative is recorded without inventing a stored value; serialized validation accepts the existing subset only.

Equipment container lifecycle (open)

Does equipping move an instance into an equipment container or retain its bag placement while EquipmentSet owns equipped references? What exact equip/unequip request branch selects the slot?

Alternatives: Use explicit equipment-container placement and slot mapping. / Retain personal container placement and derive equipped use from EquipmentSet.
Recommendation: Choose one placement authority and specify slot/version handling before implementing equip operations.
Impact: No bag-slot occupancy rule or implicit second owner is invented; current ownership and slot contracts preserve the supported portions.
